svg.text: One millimetre scale; orange dashed shapes are reserves, not selected-MPN geometry.
• both 75×150-mm panels use the same millimetre scale
• every solid component envelope comes from the MPN register
• full U214 and Keystone holder envelopes do not overlap
• exact components clear all M2.5 hole/head keep-outs
↑ / ↓ / ← / → interface faces through that enclosure edge
⊗ touch/press enters face ⊙ sound/module leaves face
physical actual-TX evidence for each transmitting path
S3, C5, 3×nRF24, CC and voice get antenna-local indicators.
IR gets its own indicator; the two Si4732 ports are RX-only.
dashed — reserved space; exact MPN is not selected
RF connectors are barrels with hex nuts, not circles.
SMA: GCT RFPC-SMA31-FN-175-A · 6 GHz · IP67 · 1.6-mm PCB.
RP-SMA: GCT RFPC-SMA32-FN-175-A · same panel cut-out.
Dimensioned projection — not an enclosure release drawing.
Caps/knob, enclosure wall stack and internal cable lengths remain open.
Controls retain D-pad + OK, BACK, OPT, F1/F2, PTT, STOP and RE-ARM.
